topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: I heard the news today that my neighbor plans to install a fence. It’s a surprise, this sudden need to mark boundaries. We’ve always had an understanding, a shared openness that seemed to work well for both of us. The thought of tall, unyielding wood standing where there once was easy access makes the afternoon seem a bit dimmer. I wonder if I should reach out, offer a hand, maybe suggest we choose the fence together. It feels like the kind of decision that should be shared. After all, it’s not just a fence, is it? It’s a change, a shift in the quiet rhythm we’ve both grown used to. I’ll wait, give it some time. Maybe tomorrow, things will look different.
